forecast_inputs: Reuse saved ex-ante GARCH/EWMA and ML forecasts; rolling21 uses the same past-only 756-return fit and exact expiry integration. No refitting or parameter selection using P&L.
long_entry: forecast > max(decision call ask-IV, put ask-IV) + 0.03, and original estimated_long_edge > 0
short_entry: forecast < min(decision call bid-IV, put bid-IV) - 0.03, and original estimated_short_edge > 0; skip if original early-exercise-risk trigger is already active at decision
entry_risk_filter: Known decision-time trigger only; frozen before short-only P&L. Prevents entering and immediately closing the same short position at the same snapshot.
exercise_model: Original proactive early-exercise-risk close rule, not an actual exercise/assignment or broker-margin simulation
execution: Same 09:45 NY decision, 10:00 entry, 15-minute lagged Greeks, whole-share 60-minute hedges, and pre-expiry closing rules
no_execution_cost_definition: Same selected trades, orders and holding periods, executable orders at observed midpoints, zero commissions/sell surcharge/slippage. Keep financing and borrow. Abandoned zero-bid long rights still recover zero, not fictional midpoint sales.
cash_accounting: Net = option mid change + stock hedge mark P&L + stock dividends - executed-order bid/ask cost - fees - slippage - abandonment writeoff + financing less idle-cash benchmark and stock borrow
vol_bet_metric: Actual entry-to-exit 15-minute/overnight realized vol compared with actual execution-time ask-IV max for long, bid-IV min for short. Undefined diagnostics stay undefined and do not discard cash P&L.
capital: Original independently funded 3 times entry 100-share stock notional; not exchange margin or a combined portfolio
scope: Same 480 candidates, results paired across all models on common eligible data; all failures reported. Models and costs fixed; no threshold optimization.
research_status: Exploratory historical comparison on already inspected 2022-2025 outcomes
